title: For All of you, it's the Mall - for me it's the Subway. Every. Single. Time.
content: A month ago, [I made this post](https://www.reddit.com/r/Paranormal/comments/vjc0dk/something_is_trying_to_contact_me_through_my/) in which, me a basically boring middle age man, started to "connect" with something in my sleep. A few people were interested, and like the post talks about, I was really trying to do lucid dreaming or something to be conscious during dreams - like everything else I'm guessing it's a skill that takes time and practice, I haven't gotten any better at it The last month all of my dreams have been really normal, back to "mine" - until last night. Like the "memory" dream - I remember this quite clear. I was on a train, but it wasn't a train anywhere on Earth - it was as though they were asking me to "describe" a train and they were building it from my memories and images so they could give me a "visual" that my mind could accept. It was a subway, but going WAY too fast and it was very big, like 4x the width of what Im used to- everything also looked pretty dilapidated - I remember at one point even seeing a bunch of debris on one side oof the car blocking entry into another car. At another point I also got grossed out because looking outside of the windows the tunnels didn't look "built" - it basically gave me the feeling of a large insect hive. The tunnels looked organic. There were other people/entities/beings? Something in the car, but it was very clear I was not allowed to see them, the same way they couldn't see me. At one point I can clearly remember trying to look at someone who was seated on the train and a voice that wasn't mine saying "stop trying, it won't work" The train stopped and everyone got off - I remember feeling a little surprised, that we would expect "another world" to be pristing and perfect, but what I was seeing looked really fallen apart and messy - I was led to the end of a stairway and told "this was the exit" - like an idiot I climbed up the stairs, everything went bright white and then I woke up. This is now the 8th clear dream I have in this subway - to such a degree that even the "sense" of it is now familiar. I am scared and excited and just wondering - wtf.
